data.completion_memo: Added the repeatable qa/milestone-02.sh command and updated process-boundary verification to allow local-store persistence libraries while continuing to reject sideways Aworkit process dependencies. The local-store test suite now covers lossless JSON/schema and CAS conflicts; atomic semantic event/attempt/checkpoint/dedup/outbox commit and stale-head rollback; secret rejection; prepared artifact finalize/read safety; deterministic projection rebuild; and startup/backup safety. Milestone 02 QA and cargo test --workspace both pass.
data.description: Create automated QA tests for all Milestone 02 repositories, including lossless JSON round trips, optimistic conflicts, atomic event/checkpoint/outbox commits, deduplication, crash points, migrations, corrupt-store degradation, backup/restore, artifact orphan handling, and deterministic projection rebuilds.
data.title: M02.QA — Create QA tests for canonical local persistence
